campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine:
overgo improves models, and itself, through its own inference and training, unattended. Every row closes or speeds up the improvement loop (measure, find the gap, train or change, judge on held-out data, promote or revert), or directly serves inference or training; otherwise it is not filed. The milestone is the loop itself (improvement-loop): from there, the scorecard's gaps generate the work.

Finish partly landed rows before opening new ones. A consolidation reuses an existing owner and deletes the implementations it replaces in the same landing. A new shared component is allowed only when no existing owner can serve several real consumers, and it must remove more than it adds.

One meaningful run serves every obligation whose identity and contract match: it is written once, as one record with many readers. A run never judges what it produced.

A change's landing cost is read from its diff, not declared: what it expires (the inference-surface guards, pinned-media reviewed deltas) and which lanes it reaches. Changes that expire evidence land together in one batch, so lanes and guard re-acquisition run once; the others land alone. Before a batch lands, the packages its device lanes will run run on the device first. The gate writes all numbers; messages name causes, effects and what disappears.

Each row's rationale carries four plain lines: Serves (the loop stage, or the model or capability it runs or trains), Disappears (the owner reused, the implementations deleted, the tests retired or kept), Evidence (the run and record it reads or produces, and who else reads that record), Batch (surface, pinned media or host, as its diff will show).

items.title: Close the improvement loop: scorecard gaps become the work, and a held-out verdict promotes or reverts

steps.title: Close the improvement loop: scorecard gaps become the work, and a held-out verdict promotes or reverts
steps.verify: go test ./cmd/validate -run '^TestScorecardHasNoUnexplainedCell$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/loop -run '^TestLoopPromotesOnlyOnHeldOutFitness$' -count=1 && go test ./cmd/loop -run '^(TestScorecardGapsBecomeProposals|TestPromotionWaitsForAHoldingScorecard)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/server -run '^TestServingFailureBecomesAFinding$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
The milestone. The scorecard's gaps become rows as plain plan data; a held-out verdict then promotes master to main or reverts. Real serving failures (local, opt-in) become findings and scorecard cells.

Absorbed 2026-09-29, rationale kept:

user-scorecard (One user-facing scorecard across every model, the definition of improvement):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/validate -run '^TestScorecardHasNoUnexplainedCell$' -count=1`: Absorbs, 2026-09-27: model-regression-baseline (full text catalog, both prompt shapes, required contexts, rates and peak/retained memory under budgets, accepted record ids pinned), benchmark-completion (compare only cells whose checkpoint, precision, split, shots, template, scoring and extraction agree; keep the 100-case MMLU label; TestAcceptedPublishedComparison rejects omitted cells, duplicates, stale identities and failed outcomes), final-model-validation (a bounded long-lived server run: concurrency, context grow and shrink, cancellation, failure, reload, VRAM plateauing within budget), benchmark-27b (operator only, -budget 3h per launch, resuming exact remaining cases; the row reads completed evidence and never starts the pass), gemma-12b-accuracy (the unquantized google/gemma-4-12B-it was downloaded 2026-09-28 on the owner's answer, to compare with the 12B FP8 twins, which score 0.5-1.2 nats per token worse than E4B on the guard corpus while overgo's 12B graph matches the transformers reference, so the suspect is the third-party quant) and validate-all-models (RAE is the remaining unvalidated model, rae-generation-path). Done when every model's row has every cell measured or carrying a stated reason. Correction 2026-09-28: the lanes are not off the landing path. d836b7deb put them back, and the landing now runs eight lanes (device, webui, model-journey, audio, thoughtbank, integration, cuda, e4b) when a change reaches them. Owner answer 2026-09-28: the full scorecard runs from the loop when the plan empties, not on a schedule. The scheduled step landed that path: validate -run, then validate -scorecard -publish writes a record beside the store with what moved since the previous one. What it still lacks, taken on here: validate -run binds a re-acquisition command only for the guard. Each modality run the scheduled step named needs its own command before the loop's scorecard measures it rather than reads old records: tabular, vqa, projection, training, activity detection, every model that is not its task's smallest, and latent-image scratch seeding.

loop-fitness-scorecard (Drive the unattended loop by the scorecard: its gaps are the work, its held-out cells the fitness):
- chain, verify `go test ./internal/loop -run '^TestLoopPromotesOnlyOnHeldOutFitness$' -count=1`: Owner recommendation 2026-09-27: chain the existing model-loop parts (internal/loop strategy, experiment, held-out fitness, rollout promotion) into one path, with the circuit breaker and rollback as guards, whose fitness is the scorecard's held-out cells.
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/loop -run '^TestScorecardGapsBecomeProposals$' -count=1`: A scheduled scorecard regression, or the weakest metric, becomes a typed proposal the unattended loop admits (plan -admit-proposal), so its work comes from what users feel. Keep the held-out rows high so the loop improves real quality rather than its own tests.

promote-on-scorecard (Promote master to main only when the scorecard holds, and revert on a regression):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/loop -run '^TestPromotionWaitsForAHoldingScorecard$' -count=1`: Owner recommendation 2026-09-27. main mirrors master, so unattended changes reach users directly. Promote master to main automatically only when the scorecard shows no regression, and revert automatically when one appears, so users see only improvements and nobody has to watch releases. Until this lands, pushing stays on the owner's explicit request.

usage-signal-findings (Turn real serving failures into findings and scorecard cells (local, opt-in)):
- do, verify `go test ./internal/server -run '^TestServingFailureBecomesAFinding$' -count=1`: Owner recommendation 2026-09-27. Benchmarks miss what users hit. The server already records serving observations per request (time to first token via the prefill sample, outcome, peak device memory); make the recording an explicit local opt-in, feed the scorecard from it, and turn every crash or refusal into a finding automatically, so real failures become the unattended loop's work supply beside the benchmark's gaps.

Serves: measure, find the gap, promote or revert. Disappears: the separate scorecard, fitness and promotion paths. Evidence: the scorecard run (validate -run, then validate -scorecard -publish, from the loop when the plan empties) is the promotion evidence; nothing is measured twice. Batch: host.

items.title: Give every remaining trainer a train route that publishes a checkpoint

steps.title: Give every remaining trainer a train route that publishes a checkpoint
steps.verify: go test ./cmd/train -run '^(TestDenseToMoERoutePublishesCheckpoint|TestTrainRoutesReachTheMediaTrainers|TestSeq2SeqRoutePublishesCheckpoint)$' -count=1 && go test ./cmd/dataset-catalog -run '^TestCatalogPublishesAMixture$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/thoughtbank -run '^TestBankTrainerHasAUserPath$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/controllertrain -run '^TestControllerTrainingHasAUserPath$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Every trainer only tests reach becomes a route on the shared run and publishes a checkpoint (capabilities-not-dead-code).

Absorbed 2026-09-29, rationale kept:

seq2seq-trainer-to-tests (Wire the seq2seq trainer to a route and a train command):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/seq2seq-train-probe -run '^TestSeq2SeqRouteNamesItsTrainer$' -count=1`: Wire the seq2seq trainer (SQA-013, re-scoped by owner directive). Needle-seq2seq is registered, and docs/model_compatibility.json records a real-artifact training smoke (1a92893f), but no command or route reaches seq2seq.Trainer; 5e1be7c0 then moved its NewTrainer into the modeltest-tagged test file. Restore NewTrainer to production, add cmd/seq2seq-train-probe following the other *-train-probe commands, and add a route in docs/training_routes.json keyed by the architecture the Needle checkpoint declares. Its GSM8K training tests get a lane that runs them rather than a tag nothing enables. Done when TestSeq2SeqRouteNamesItsTrainer resolves the Needle checkpoint's architecture to the new trainer and the probe trains one step on a synthetic pair.

wire-dense-to-moe (Wire modelmerge's dense-to-MoE upcycling to a train route):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/train -run '^TestDenseToMoERoutePublishesCheckpoint$' -count=1`: Found 2026-09-29 by the unexport-and-deadcode pass on internal/model. deadcode reports model.NewDenseToMoERouterEvidence, CompileDenseToMoERouter, deriveDenseToMoELayer and screenDenseToMoERouter unreachable from every command.

internal/modelmerge/dense_to_moe.go is their only production caller, and no command reaches it either. The capability is dense-to-MoE upcycling: it derives expert centroids from activation evidence, and admits the router only when every held-out label wins with a strict routing margin. It is a trainer path that only tests call, so per capabilities-not-dead-code it is unwired, not dead.

Wire it: give it a cmd/train route, or a verb of the merge command if one exists. Its input is a dense model plus activation evidence, and its output is a published MoE checkpoint. A route test must publish the upcycled checkpoint on a tiny fixture. If the owner decides upcycling is out of the product, delete modelmerge's dense-to-MoE path and model's router with it.

wire-dataset-mixture (Publish weighted dataset mixtures for training):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/dataset-catalog -run '^TestCatalogPublishesAMixture$' -count=1`: 5e1be7c0 moved dataset.NewMixture into tests. trainingdata's materializer already materializes TypeMixture with member weights (internal/trainingdata/materializer.go), but nothing in production can publish a mixture document, so no objective can train on a weighted mix of corpora. Restore NewMixture and add dataset-catalog -mixture <name> -members <alias>=<weight>,... to publish one. Done when TestCatalogPublishesAMixture publishes a two-member mixture and the materializer reads its weights back.

wire-bank-trainer (Give the thoughtbank bank trainer a user path):
- do, verify `go test ./internal/thoughtbank -run '^TestBankTrainerHasAUserPath$' -count=1`: internal/thoughtbank/bank_train.go's FastWeightBankTrainer is production code only a test calls, the same orphaned-capability pattern the audit found (2026-09-24). thoughtbank inference is wired as a generation capability (internal/mediacapability). Give the bank trainer a train command and a route or training workspace entry for the thoughtbank models it serves, and a lane for its tests. Done when TestBankTrainerHasAUserPath resolves a route or command to FastWeightBankTrainer.

retire-controller-cluster (Wire the controller training cluster to a user path):
- do, verify `go test ./internal/controllertrain -run '^TestControllerTrainingHasAUserPath$' -count=1`: Wire the controller training cluster, owner directive 2026-09-24: wire all training code in instead of deleting it. internal/controllertrain has no production importer; internal/controlleraction is reached only by cmd/controller-action, which nothing refers to; no controller-* schema has been written to the master store. About 2,790 production and 2,140 test lines. Find the model or controller artifact it trains, give it a train command and a docs/training_routes.json route or a training workspace entry, and give its tests a lane. Done when TestControllerTrainingHasAUserPath resolves a route or command to controllertrain.

wire-media-trainers (Wire the diffusion-image and joint speech trainers to train routes):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/train -run '^TestTrainRoutesReachTheMediaTrainers$' -count=1`: Verified 2026-09-28: diffusionimage.NewTrainer (train.go) and speechsynth.NewJointTrainer (trainer.go) are production code that only tests call. mediacapability imports both packages for inference only. Under the capabilities-not-dead-code rule, each gets a route through trainer-shared-run's shared run, for the image and speech models it serves, and its tests get a lane.

Serves: the train stage for every trainer the repository holds. Disappears: probes and test-only entry points. Evidence: each trainer's first real run is its acceptance and its scorecard training cell. Batch: mostly pinned media (diffusionimage, routedlm, latentvideo), riding those batches.

steps.title: Measure the improver: wall, refusals, rework and cost per landed row, and the worst-case landing
steps.rationale:
Owner recommendation 2026-09-27. The loop's own speed decides how fast users see improvement. Beside the user scorecard, report from git (Landed-Row trailers and the Measured by the gate lines) and the loop's own records: wall time per landed row, refused landings per landed row, rework (rows reopened or reverted), agent cost per landed row, and the worst-case landing -- a change to a widely imported package such as internal/tensor or internal/artifact that invalidates most of the test cache. That is the next speed cliff: today's one-minute landings are narrow changes.

Serves: loop speed, minimally. Disappears: nothing is added: the slowest lane and the worst-case landing are read from the gate's lines in git log; no store records, no new tool. Batch: host.

items.title: Have every GPU user take the device claim lanes wait on

budget.reason: the swap launcher's wait for device admission

steps.title: Have every GPU user take the device claim lanes wait on
steps.rationale:
Three sessions share one GPU. Preview servers started through launch.json hold the device while gate lanes time out behind them, and on 2026-09-23 a server of unknown origin was killed to free it. A served model should hold the same claim, so a lane waits for it and names it (01cbf544) instead of timing out. 2026-09-25: the device lane of 69368990 failed 'physical resource is already reserved' in devicemath while two other gate processes held the GPU, and passed unchanged on re-run; a claim every GPU user takes turns that into a wait with a named holder instead of a failed lane and a manual re-run. Found 2026-09-26: every CUDA context already takes the shared device claim (driver.ContextCreate calls processcontrol.ShareResource), so a served model holds it for its context's life, and a timed-out exclusive wait already names its holders (01cbf544, TestResourceWaitNamesItsHolders). What remains is proof, not mechanism: a device test that a served model's context holds the claim an exclusive reservation then waits on.

Serves: loop speed. Disappears: the unclaimed GPU users that cause lane refusals. Batch: host.

items.title: Move live-evidence acceptance tests off the landing path

steps.title: Move live-evidence acceptance tests off the landing path
steps.rationale:
Owner review 2026-09-27. Measured: 088a4774c's test stage re-ran 17 suites for 6 min 56 s (audioparity 376 s, cmd/compatibility 192 s, capabilityruntime 122 s, modelintake 119 s, server 71 s) because plan -stop had written a record into the live store at 17:56:23; the next plan-only landing, with no store write before it, ran 4 packages in 40 s. Suites that read the live store re-run on every store write, and their verdict depends on the machine's store rather than the commit. The gate runs go test with OVERGO_DATA_ROOT pointing at an empty scratch directory and OVERGO_AUDIO_REFERENCE_STORE unset (construction: no test can reach the live store through the environment); the 16 test files that name the store by path (overgodb-store, gitauthority.CanonicalOvergoDBDirectory) become hermetic on fixtures or scratch stores, or move off the landing path to the scheduled scorecard and validate, where live-store checks belong. Predicted effect: landings stop paying for store writes; a narrow landing's test stage stays near a minute. Measured 2026-09-27 before starting: with the data root pointed at an empty directory, 133 tests in 77 files across 12 packages fail (cmd/compatibility 32 files, internal/audioparity 19, internal/evaluation 10, speechsynth, server and others): retained-evidence acceptance tests and a few live model-file tests. They re-run when the evidence changes, which is correct; the measured 7-minute landing came from a control record (plan -stop) written into the evidence store, which stop-state-out-of-store removes. Moving them means splitting mixed files across 12 packages and a scheduled evidence run. Do it only if dev-loop measurement shows real evidence writes costing landings. Re-raised 2026-09-27 under landing-wall-budget: the four slowest suites a landing re-runs are these, and they re-run on dependency changes as well as store writes, so the stop-file fix alone does not bring landings under the budget. Updated 2026-09-27 after 32ad2b892: the store-write cause is gone. The data lives outside the module folder, so a store write re-runs nothing. The audio acceptances run in their own lane (780d83550). What remains is hermeticity: these suites' verdicts depend on the machine's data. That does not speed up landings, because a lane would run exactly when their code changes, as go test does now. So the row ranks after the user-visible fixes. Measured 2026-09-28 after the lanes landed: go test ./... with OVERGO_DATA_ROOT on an empty folder fails 92 tests in 12 packages: cmd/compatibility 56 (40 top-level accepted-evidence and acceptance projections, opening the store through retainedReferenceStore in 34 places and dataroot.Resolve in about 36), internal/evaluation 16, internal/speechsynth 7, internal/server 4, internal/audioparity 2, and one each in oscillatorimage, modelintake, dataset, capabilityruntime, cmd/smoke-lane, cmd/longform and cmd/benchmark-report. The work: consolidate each package's live-store entry into one helper behind testskip.StoreAcceptance, and run the packages in a store lane (without the five failing audits, tracked in refresh-accepted-evidence). The benefit is hermeticity only: with the data outside the module, a lane runs these exactly when go test does now. Ranked after plan-tool-plain-data.

Serves: loop speed. Disappears: live-evidence suites on the landing path. Batch: host.

items.title: Fold cmd/compatibility into validate, re-verifying claims whose source moves

steps.title: Fold cmd/compatibility into validate, re-verifying claims whose source moves
steps.rationale:
cmd/compatibility (about 16k lines) folds into validate. Claims re-verify when their source moves (owner). Stale acceptances are refreshed by re-running them, never by hand; the census acceptance still waits on the owner's review of the 11 new identities.

Absorbed 2026-09-29, rationale kept:

compatibility-reports-leave-the-tree (Re-verify compatibility claims whose source moved, and fold cmd/compatibility into validate):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/compatibility -run '^TestCompatibilityReportsAreRenderedOnDemand' -count=1`: Owner answer 2026-09-27: a claim's file:sha256 source binding means re-verify. A claim whose bound source moved is re-verified (its oracle re-runs), because a stale claim that a model works is exactly the false promise users hit. Today the gate rewrites compatibility.json and COMPATIBILITY.md on every landing unreviewed. Then docs/model_compatibility.json and docs/media_report.json leave the tree. Owner review 2026-09-27: its checks are plain tests now, so fold cmd/compatibility (4k lines of code, 12k of tests, plus compatibility.json and docs/verification/) into cmd/validate and cut its tests to behaviour. compatibility-names-its-reads is retired: go test's cache tracks what the package reads. About 10k lines.

refresh-accepted-evidence (Refresh the stale accepted evidence and decide the reference-dependent tests):
- do, verify `OVERGO_STORE_ACCEPTANCE=1 go test ./cmd/compatibility ./cmd/longform -run '^(TestAcceptedCapabilityCensus|TestAcceptedE4BResourceRefresh|TestAcceptedFP8Guard|TestRetiredGuardRecords|TestAcceptedGuardCatalog)$' -count=1 -v`: Split from env-gated-tests-run-or-go on 2026-09-28, once every CUDA-gated package had a lane. What remains needs the owner's call or a long evidence run.
(1) The five accepted-evidence audits fail against the live store, run with OVERGO_STORE_ACCEPTANCE=1:
- TestAcceptedE4BResourceRefresh: the resource evidence does not bind the current inference surface. Refresh it by running TestE4BMediaResourceRecovery with OVERGO_E4B_PUBLISH_RESOURCES=1, about 220 s.
- TestAcceptedCapabilityCensus: snapshot 209 identities, live 220. The owner records a disposition before the denominator is replaced.
- TestAcceptedFP8Guard, TestRetiredGuardRecords and TestAcceptedGuardCatalog: the guard evidence lacks realized residency, and the cohort is empty. That needs the long-form guard run, about 80 minutes on the GPU.
(2) Tests that need a reference the Go-only rule cannot produce: the Fractale leadership tests (OVERGO_FRACTALE_BASELINE), Krea (OVERGO_KREA_BASELINE), Pocket TTS (OVERGO_POCKET_TTS_BASELINE) and the Qwen3.5 projector fixture (a golden of its internal activations). The owner decides whether to keep each and wait for a reference, or delete it if a running test covers it.
(3) The full-length runs, Wan's 81-frame clip (OVERGO_WAN_FULL) and SenseNova's full generation (OVERGO_SENSENOVA_FULL): the lane budget for each once measured.
Done when the audits pass.
Progress 2026-09-28:
- The E4B resource proof was refreshed on the current surface (TestE4BMediaResourceRecovery with OVERGO_E4B_PUBLISH_RESOURCES=1, 262 s): gate evidence:sha256:31c095ade3464244d1fe11b8ac62f50a17c66026c1c52eeca47cb9422d3d1ea8, run run:sha256:bca22c0744a247457d617cf64541d1f3e18429cd8be1ae03c75bdf5efa611f2a. TestAcceptedE4BResourceRefresh still fails because it reads docs/verification/e4b-resource-refresh.json, a hand-assembled binding (the surface digest and 24 protocol and resource cell identities) that no producer writes, so it expires on every surface move. Derive the current binding from the store's newest proofs for the E4B recipe on the current surface, or retire the audit; do not hand-edit the ledger.
- Census: the owner answered "review the 11 new identities, then accept". The acceptance takes compatibility -publish-census from a clean tree, then a finding and a closed disposition bound in cmd/compatibility/testdata/accepted_census.json, as bf765bc07 did for 209.
- Python goldens are always allowed (owner), so the reference-dependent tests in (2) get their references from Python. Progress 2026-09-29: TestAcceptedE4BResourceRefresh is retired with its hand-assembled ledger (e4b-resource-refresh.json) and the git-history helpers only it used. Deriving the binding could not work: the resource proofs record no surface, and the protocol proofs come from another producer, frozen at 6ee3478c. The device-resource tests assert E4B's bounds each run, TestAcceptedE4BModalities checks the accepted cells, and the scorecard reports current peak memory. Four audits remain; the verify drops the retired name when this row closes.

media-campaign-one-record (Fold the media campaign's receipts into fewer committed records):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/compatibility -run '^TestMediaCampaignIsOneRecord$' -count=1`: Owner decision 2026-09-26: evidence and reports stay committed to git, so the frozen media receipts are not moved into the store. The campaign spans 21 docs/image_video_*.json files, media_reviewed_deltas.json, media_report.json, MEDIA_REPORT.md and docs/media_samples; 15 receipts are read only by cmd/compatibility tests, each pinned by its own canonical-JSON digest constant (image_video_*_test.go via checkMediaProtocolIdentity), and image_video_merged.json carries the runtime_sha256 and runtime_paths the gate reads. Any fold is a pinned-evidence move landed in one commit with its digests (runtime-evidence-substrate); scope it only if one committed record can replace several pins without weakening them.

Serves: the measure stage. Disappears: cmd/compatibility's separate claims, reports and campaign records. Evidence: validate's run records. Batch: host, except the guard re-acquisition runs. From test-models-from-store, 2026-09-29: when the specialized-coverage and image_video acquisition records are re-verified, migrate the frozen tests they pin: the three thoughtbank model tests to modeltest.Directory(t, "Fractale-350M-base"), and delete runtime_cuda_windows_test.go's OVERGO_WAN_MODEL setenv (wanModelDir already resolves Wan through the store).

items.title: Lock ports with goldens under one provenance manifest and delete the parity packages

steps.title: Lock ports with goldens under one provenance manifest and delete the parity packages
steps.rationale:
Goldens in git under one provenance manifest lock the ports, so the reference-comparison packages and their generators go.

Absorbed 2026-09-29, rationale kept:

goldens-provenance (Keep goldens in git under one provenance manifest and delete their Python generators):
- do, verify `go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^TestGoldensHaveProvenance$' -count=1`: Owner direction 2026-09-26. 177 tracked goldens (4.3 MB, the largest about 1 MB) stay where they are in git -- fixtures/ and package testdata -- because git is the durable, pushed copy, the store is local and has been rebuilt, a golden in git never makes its test skip, and moving them would churn the tests and the records that pin them. What they lack is provenance. One manifest in fixtures/ records, for each golden, its upstream repository and commit, its checkpoint identity, its input digest and its own digest; TestGoldensHaveProvenance refuses a golden without an entry or whose bytes differ from it. The upstream output itself is kept, not just a parity verdict: kernels legitimately move numbers, and only the upstream output re-checks parity after each move without re-running Python, where comparing against overgo's own old output would stack tolerances. The Python generators are deleted -- internal/parity/testdata/make_olmoe_tiny.py and those in tmp (timesfm3_golden.py, dinov2_golden.py, generate_kimi_k3_rank_reference.py and their inputs) -- because the manifest names what to re-run if upstream ever changes; no Python is tracked. The store holds only a future golden too large for git; none is today.

parity-packages-to-goldens (Delete the reference-comparison packages whose ports goldens lock):
- do, verify `go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^TestEveryTrackedFileHasAReader$' -count=1`: Owner 2026-09-26: once a port is locked by goldens, the reference-comparison packages go. internal/adaptiveparity, cmd/sensenovaparity and cmd/vqaparity have no production importer; each is deleted once the comparisons it runs exist as committed goldens with provenance (goldens-provenance: goldens stay in git). internal/audioparity is not pure comparison -- internal/mediacapability and cmd/webui-lane import it for ASR qualification and election -- so its production part moves to its owner and only its comparison part goes. No new rule: done when go list no longer finds the three packages and the tree still builds and vets. Check: the reader census, since deleting the packages must leave none of their fixtures or testdata behind; done also when go list no longer finds them.

Absorbed 2026-09-29, rationale kept:

command-subcommand-tables (Fold the model-file, store and parity commands into subcommand tables):
- fold-parity-tools, verify `go test ./cmd/validate -run '^TestParitySubcommandsReplaceTheirCommands$' -count=1 -v`: 
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/gguf ./cmd/overgodb ./cmd/validate -run '^Test(GGUF|OvergoDB|Parity)SubcommandsReplaceTheirCommands$' -count=1 -v`: Split from automation-command-route-tables when its training-probe half completed (the eight probes are cmd/train routes; 85 commands remain at b889bd746). The same row named three more families to fold, smallest proof first: the model-file tools into cmd/gguf subcommands (gguf-hash, gguf-merge, gguf-quantize, gguf-split, inspect-gguf, inspect-safetensors, hf-gguf-convert, gemma4-gguf-convert, audio-inspect), the store tools into cmd/overgodb subcommands (overgodb-backup, -import, -query, -rebuild, -repair, store-check, store-precheck), and the parity tools into cmd/validate -parity (audio-oracle, sensenovaparity, vqaparity). Split into one step per family when dispatched. Traps the probe folds found: move files with git mv so the gate's rules compare a moved file against its old content (literals and growth); check docs/*.json for pinned paths first (docs/media_reviewed_deltas.json, lifecycle, validation, coverage records, compatibility.json evidence) and reconcile a pinned move with a reviewed delta; keep verification receipts and stimulus files byte-identical; edit JSON through a decode/re-encode program; each command removed regenerates docs/api_manifest.json, which reruns cmd/compatibility until compatibility-cache-inputs lands.

lane-commands-folded (Fold the lane commands the gate does not call into test packages):
- do, verify `go test ./cmd/gate -run '^TestUncalledLaneCommandsGone$' -count=1`:  Owner review 2026-09-27: internal/landing/lanes.go calls only device-lane and webui-lane. eval-lane, race-lane, smoke-lane, test-lane, train-lane and composite-generation-lane are named only by the plan, cmd/validate (smoke_records.go), README, skill.md, generated documents and a few tests. Fold what is still needed into test packages (train-lane's training routes keep running as tests: training is a capability, not a lane) and delete the rest. About 2k lines.

simplify-command-surface (Consolidate duplicated APIs and shipped binaries):
- do, verify `go run ./cmd/preflight && test -f internal/apimanifest/ownership_consolidation_test.go && go test ./internal/apimanifest -run '^TestOwnershipConsolidationContracts$' -count=1`: Rank duplicates by real callers and build, test, startup and packaging cost using command-discovery's inventory. Before starting, pick a concrete owner and bind the old-to-new caller map; migrate code, automation, manifests and docs in one batch and delete the displaced implementation and build target. A dispatcher over unchanged handlers does not count. Preserve public flags, schemas, exit codes, streaming, cancellation and evidence contracts. TestOwnershipConsolidationContracts rejects stale references and proves a smaller surface.

Serves: the operator surface. Disappears: the lane commands the gate does not call and the parity commands; the model-file, store and parity commands become subcommand tables. Batch: host.

steps.rationale: The overgo_vae lane (branch codex/overgo_vae, campaign overgo_rsi_with_vae, design docs/overgo_rsi_with_vae.md) runs the native-Go latent RSI and PEARL campaign with its own plan in its own worktree. Owner decision 2026-09-25: master takes the lane in parts that have a production consumer, not whole. Master ported the runtime part at e1ee1326fe2b (row vae-codec-stream-port: media.CodecChunkStream owning causal codec state, the Wan VAE host and CUDA encode and CUDA decode through it; the host streaming DecodeLatentVideo stays a test on master until it has a production caller); the ported files are byte-identical to the lane's, so merging master back is clean. DIRECTION FOR THE LANE when it merges master (master is in a consolidation-only phase: two birds with one stone, minimize to the maximum practical extent, no ledger where construction can prevent the object): (1) consumer first -- land each latent contract (representation latent state and codec, geometry, tensorstats resampling and robust scalars, media latent volume) together with its first production consumer; the first merge unit is first-latent-capability/existing-vae-inference-proof, and no export arrives without a caller; (2) no new record families -- express experimental evidence through the shared record table that automation-one-record-table builds instead of runrecord experimental_* families, and keep campaign-history adoption out of master's internal/plan; (3) reconcile pinned media runtime moves with a reviewed delta in docs/media_reviewed_deltas.json backed by a device receipt, never by narrowing TestReviewedDeltaRegistryExplainsTheTree; (4) never raise docs/clone_baseline.json -- the merged tree measured 7964 against master's 7991 while the lane raised it to 9970; (5) after merging master, drop the lane's testCodecChunkState copy in internal/media/codec_latent_test.go: master's TestCodecChunkStreamOwnsCausalState owns it; (6) keep evidence identities in compatibility.json refreshed from master's store, not the lane's. Master keeps its plan; any staged surface a later merge brings retires with this row.
